items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: Because we used to get a lot of music from Jean Goldkette, you know.

ctx.x: He was with Earle Warren, working at the Majestic Ballroom. He had a good gig there. Very good gig. I got in with... He tried to get a couple of jobs down there, but I couldn't make it reading, you know. But I ended up with a little group that they called... They used to be the Nighthawks, then they changed their name to the Chocolate Dandies. This was below Hastings(?) Street. It was a (?)jump band(?).. They didn't read too well either, you know.
